HeuristicLodDomain.doc: lod:domain on a UsdLodHeuristic must be non-empty.

DistanceHeuristicThresholds.doc: thresholds must be strictly increasing; blendThresholds (if present) must satisfy thresholds[i] <= blendThresholds[i] <= thresholds[i+1].

ScreenSizeHeuristicThresholds.doc: thresholds must be strictly decreasing; blendThresholds (if present) must satisfy thresholds[i+1] <= blendThresholds[i] <= thresholds[i]; projectionMethod must be a valid token; extent (if present) must be empty or have exactly 2 elements.

LodOverrideApiMode.doc: lod:override:mode must be one of the allowed tokens; if mode is indexedLOD, lod:override:index must be readable.

LodRootApiHeuristics.doc: lod:heuristics relationship targets must resolve to prims that IsA UsdLodHeuristic.
